title: Motor imagery + spatial attention dataset from Forenzo & He 2023
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 25 healthy human subjects performing a multi-session brain-computer interface (BCI) study combining motor imagery (MI) and overt spatial attention (OSA) tasks, including a combined MIOSA condition. Subjects imagined left- or right-hand movements to control a cursor via continuous visual feedback across five sessions with three motor imagery runs each. The dataset was converted to BIDS format using MOABB and is derived from the original study by Forenzo & He (2023) investigating integration of motor imagery and spatial attention for EEG-BCI control.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a 64-channel Neuroscan Quik-Cap with SynAmps 2/RT amplifiers at a 1000 Hz sampling rate, referenced between Cz and CPz, following the standard_1005 montage. Online filters included a lowpass at 200 Hz and a 60 Hz notch filter. Participants performed motor imagery tasks (left_hand, right_hand) with 6-second trial durations, synchronous online feedback via cursor control, and continuous visual pursuit stimuli. Signal processing involved AR spectral estimation, alpha bandpower feature extraction (8-13 Hz), Laplacian spatial filtering, and linear classification evaluated within-subject.
